name: Fairmont Waterfront
positioning: Fairmont hotel on Vancouver's harbour, with a rooftop pool and a rooftop garden
best_for: Travelers who want to be steps from the convention centre and the cruise terminal
Guests who enjoy a rooftop garden, a heated rooftop pool and the seawall

facts.text: The hotel is on Vancouver's harbour, steps from the Vancouver Convention Centre, the cruise terminal and the seawall.
The hotel has a heated rooftop pool with panoramic views.
ARC Restaurant and Bar serves West Coast cuisine made with locally sourced ingredients and produce from the rooftop garden.
Executive Chef Harris Sakalis created the Province to Plate menu at ARC, which changes seasonally.
Guests can use a complimentary bike program to ride the seawall.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours a day.
Fairmont Gold offers a hotel-within-a-hotel experience with private check-in and exclusive lounge access.

highlights.text: A rooftop garden, launched in 1996, grows herbs, fruits, vegetables and edible blossoms without herbicides or pesticides.
The hotel runs an outdoor Bee Program, with daily Bee Tours of the apiaries in the warmer months.
A booking package with Talaysay Tours includes a 90-minute walking tour led by a local First Nations guide.

considerations.text: All guest rooms and signature suites are undergoing a renovation, which is scheduled to wrap in 2029.
Self parking is available at the hotel for $58 per night.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with urban noise levels.
